summary: Standards pass: atip_check_36 proves that seeded_verdict rejects a check forced to pass (run_l0 and check_binary_forcing take a forced_pass list that only tests use, in the public API); it does not run the per-id proves() tests against a check that never fails. My real mutations of checks.rs (always-pass after-dashdash, contract, text-error-form, version-format, no-env-switch-text) were each caught by the per-id tests, so the claim holds for the triggers they plant (see finding 2.1 for those they do not).
